notes.title: Hero Express - Streaming & Giveaway!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, [b]Fantastico Studio[/b] here!


To celebrate the arrival of the summer season we have set up a [i][b]streaming event[/b][/i] of our game: [h3][b]Hero Express![/b][/h3]



[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/48ef42_080b73543bbe4111aa85524a3dda40d5~mv2.gif[/img]



We will challenge ourselves in one of the [i][b]10 new arenas[/b][/i] available in the incredible [b][i]Zombie Madness[/i][/b] mode, where we will destroy as many zombies as we can in the shortest amount of time.


And since in [b]Fantastico Studio[/b] we are all [i]super nice[/i], during the stream will also be available an [i]amazing[/i] [i][b]giveaway[/b][/i] ! 


So we'll just have to meet up next Friday: save the date, [b]it will be fun[/b]!

notes.title: Hero Express finally available on Steam and Switch!
notes.content:
So it's finally time! Hero Express is [b]now available on Steam and Switch[/b]!!

Hero Express is a 2d physics based driving game with a crazy twist. The player's objective isn't to get to the end of the track first, but to get there alive!!! In fact you will play the role of a delivery guy, on his way to deliver a forgetful hero his super tools. Will you be able to save the day?

Don't forget the game is also available on Xbox One!

For any info join [url=https://discord.gg/VvpQqD2]our discord channel[/url]
